research_sequence_alignment.summary: Build diagnostic registry and parser fixtures first.
Harden parser/validator and table mutation safety.
Redefine release-readiness core and full traceability acceptance.
Fix package-relative rules loading and canonical root agent files.
Add index consistency validation and completed-work prevalidation/latest ordering.
Re-run release readiness for v1.2.0 and add Completed Work Log row after completion.

tasks.title: Diagnostic registry type, helper, and contract tests
tasks.reference_pattern: Use existing diagnostic factory and validation call sites, then make registry lookup mandatory.
tasks.rationale: Registry must exist before new parser, index, and release diagnostics are added.
pitfalls: Do not let registry severity drift from emit severity.
Do not exact-match context-specific full messages.
test_guide: Assert all current diagnostics are registered.
Assert rules doc table matches registry.
dod: All emitted diagnostic codes are registered.

rollback.command: 1) Remove diagnostic registry additions. 2) Restore diagnostic factory and rules doc changes from this task, then rerun validator tests.

tasks.title: Parser and validator fixture baseline for hardening
tasks.reference_pattern: Extend existing fixture copy helper and invalid-structure parser tests.
implementation_guide: Write Red assertions using registered codes.
tasks.rationale: Fixtures lock the desired hardening behavior before parser and index code changes.
pitfalls: Keep each fixture focused.
Code fence headings must create neither records nor diagnostics.
test_guide: Hardening fixtures expose one primary behavior each.
dod: Valid and hardening fixtures run through shared helpers.

rollback.command: 1) Remove fixtures and tests added by this task. 2) Keep registry files and rerun parser and validator tests.

tasks.title: Fenced-code-aware block scanner and documented block boundary
signatures: function scanRequirementBlocks(lines: string[], filePath?: string): { blocks: RequirementBlockRange[]; diagnostics: Diagnostic[] }
tasks.reference_pattern: Replace linear scan in block-scanner.ts with fenced-code state machine.
implementation_guide: End blocks at next valid heading, top-level boundary, or EOF.
tasks.rationale: Parser boundary must be deterministic before release readiness trusts docs/spec.
pitfalls: Do not keep trailing top-level sections in record markdown.
Do not emit malformed heading diagnostics inside fences.
test_guide: Assert fenced heading creates no record.
Assert fenced malformed heading creates no diagnostic.
Assert final block boundary stops before next top-level section.

rollback.command: 1) Restore block scanner and parser tests from before this task. 2) Rerun parser tests.

tasks.title: Duplicate section, nested AC, heading content, and malformed table diagnostics
signatures: function parseRequirementSections(...): { sections: Record<string, SectionRange>; diagnostics: Diagnostic[] }
function parseAcceptanceCriteria(...): { criteria: AcceptanceCriterion[]; diagnostics: Diagnostic[] }
tasks.reference_pattern: Make section, AC, and table parsers diagnostics-aware and propagate diagnostics through toRequirementRecord.
implementation_guide: Exclude nested AC from top-level criteria.
Report malformed table row cell counts.
tasks.rationale: SRS-MD structural violations must not be silently accepted.
pitfalls: Parser return type change touches multiple call sites.
Line numbers must remain actionable.

rollback.command: 1) Restore parser result shape and parser call sites from before this task. 2) Rerun parser and validator tests.

tasks.title: Shared Markdown table cell safety for every table-writing mutation
signatures: function assertSafeMarkdownTableCell(label: string, value: string): MutationResult<void> | undefined
function assertSafeMarkdownTableCells(cells: Record<string, string>): MutationResult<void> | undefined
tasks.reference_pattern: Generalize existing completed-work pipe rejection into shared helper.
implementation_guide: Use it in add-evidence and add-trace.
Return structured mutation failure before write.
tasks.rationale: Unsafe table cells corrupt the Markdown SRS source.
pitfalls: Do not validate non-table prose fields.
Coordinate changed error messages with adapter tests.
test_guide: Reject pipe, LF, CR in every table-writing mutation.
Assert file content unchanged after rejection.
dod: Shared helper used by all table writers.
Mutation tests prove no file change.

rollback.command: 1) Restore table-writing mutation files from before this task. 2) Remove table-cell helper and tests, then rerun mutation tests.

tasks.title: Release readiness target resolution and summary contract
signatures: function summarizeReleaseReadiness(workspace: ParsedWorkspace, options?: { target?: string }): ReleaseReadinessSummary
tasks.reference_pattern: Expand existing release-readiness summary and remove script hard-coded target fallback.
implementation_guide: Use active target only when explicit target is absent.
Return ready false for empty target.
tasks.rationale: Release readiness must explain blockers and evaluate the intended target.
pitfalls: Do not fallback from empty Active Target.
Keep strict exit behavior.
test_guide: Active target is used when explicit is absent.

rollback.command: 1) Restore release-readiness.ts and release-check.mjs from before this task. 2) Restore tests and rerun release readiness tests.

tasks.title: Evidence, AC coverage, trace, and command policy release gate
tasks.reference_pattern: Use evidence parser covers field and existing verified guard as the base for release-grade checks.
implementation_guide: Require checked AC for verified records.
Require evidence covers all or matching AC IDs.
Classify local path, URL, command, and opaque evidence.
Report missing local paths and invalid URLs.
tasks.rationale: Verified must mean AC-level coverage and evidence validity are provable.
pitfalls: Do not perform network calls.
Do not execute command evidence.
Keep local paths inside project root.
test_guide: Missing path, invalid URL, command violation, and broken trace appear separately.
dod: Release readiness checks AC, evidence, trace, and command policy.

rollback.command: 1) Remove release evidence gate collectors. 2) Restore release tests and rerun release acceptance.

tasks.title: Package-relative rules loading and canonical root agent files
signatures: async function upsertAgentInstruction(root: string, agentFile: AgentFileMode, output: InitProjectOutput): Promise<void>
tasks.reference_pattern: Package rules currently resolve cwd-relative; init already upserts uppercase agent files.
implementation_guide: Resolve rules relative to package module path.
Keep fallback stub only for missing artifact.
Ensure root AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are present.
tasks.rationale: Installed init must deploy full rules and canonical agent instructions outside the source checkout.
pitfalls: import.meta.url path must work after build.
Preserve unrelated user content.
test_guide: External init writes full rules doc.
Uppercase agent files contain managed block.

acceptance_tests.cmd: npx vitest run test/core/bootstrap/init-project.test.ts test/smoke/package.test.ts test/mcp/stdio-purity.test.ts --hookTimeout 60000 --testTimeout 60000 --no-file-parallelism
npx vitest run test/core/bootstrap/init-project.test.ts test/smoke/package.test.ts test/mcp/stdio-purity.test.ts --hookTimeout 60000 --testTimeout 60000 --no-file-parallelism

rollback.command: 1) Restore bootstrap and agent documentation edits from before this task. 2) Rerun bootstrap and smoke tests.

tasks.title: Shared target summary and CLI read diagnostics payloads
signatures: function summarizeTarget(workspace: ParsedWorkspace, target?: string): TargetSummary
function buildReadEnvelope<T>(workspace: ParsedWorkspace, value: T): ReadEnvelope<T>
tasks.reference_pattern: Extend existing target summary and route CLI read JSON through shared envelope.
tasks.rationale: Read outputs should carry governance diagnostics without extra commands.
pitfalls: Keep human output concise.
Do not fallback from empty Active Target.
Do not force MCP resource envelope names into CLI.
test_guide: Every read command JSON includes diagnostics summary.
dod: CLI read JSON exposes diagnostics summary.

rollback.command: 1) Restore query summary and CLI read command edits. 2) Restore read/parity tests and rerun CLI read tests.

tasks.title: MCP read parity and envelope-all resources
signatures: function registerReadTools(server: McpServerHandle, deps: McpDependencies): void
function registerResources(server: McpServerHandle, deps: McpDependencies): void
function resourceEnvelope<T>(workspace: ParsedWorkspace, value: T): ResourceEnvelope<T>
tasks.reference_pattern: Use existing MCP read tools/resources and standardize mixed shapes.
implementation_guide: Make MCP read tools call shared builders.
tasks.rationale: Agents should receive the same governance signals over MCP as CLI JSON.
pitfalls: Update completed-work raw resource expectation intentionally.
Keep readOnlyHint only on read tools.
test_guide: MCP tool payloads match CLI meaning.
Empty active target has no fallback.
dod: MCP read tools match CLI/core semantics.

acceptance_tests.cmd: npx vitest run test/mcp/read-tools-resources.test.ts test/mcp/stdio-purity.test.ts test/integration/cli-mcp-parity.test.ts --hookTimeout 60000 --testTimeout 60000 --no-file-parallelism
npx vitest run test/mcp/read-tools-resources.test.ts test/mcp/stdio-purity.test.ts test/integration/cli-mcp-parity.test.ts --hookTimeout 60000 --testTimeout 60000 --no-file-parallelism

rollback.command: 1) Restore MCP read/resource/server files from before this task. 2) Restore MCP tests and Appendix resource policy text, then rerun MCP suites.

phases.title: Index consistency and completed work policy

tasks.title: Index consistency and rollup drift validation
signatures: function parseIndexDocument(file: TextFile): { index: IndexDocument; diagnostics: Diagnostic[] }
tasks.reference_pattern: Extend existing index-related validation block with duplicate and rollup checks.
implementation_guide: Report duplicate targets and multiple active rows.
Report duplicate scopes and missing docs.
tasks.rationale: Index drift corrupts target, scope, and release control-plane decisions.
pitfalls: Separate index and scope files.
Keep released status enum aligned.
Avoid duplicate diagnostics for missing tables.
dod: Valid summary counts match computed counts.
Release readiness can consume validation diagnostics.

rollback.command: 1) Remove index consistency validation additions. 2) Restore related fixtures and rerun validator tests.

tasks.title: Completed Work Log latest ordering, prevalidation, and override
signatures: function validateCompletedWorkInput(workspace: ParsedWorkspace, input: AddCompletedWorkInput): Diagnostic[]
tasks.reference_pattern: Current completed-work query returns file order and addCompletedWork writes without reference prevalidation.
implementation_guide: Require implemented or verified IDs unless override.
tasks.rationale: Recent work reads need deterministic order and new rows must not reference incomplete work by default.
pitfalls: Target may be intentionally empty.
Reject before patch write.
Do not rewrite historical rows.

acceptance_tests.cmd: npx vitest run test/core/query/completed-work.test.ts test/core/mutation/add-completed-work.test.ts test/cli/read-commands.test.ts test/cli/mutation-commands.test.ts --hookTimeout 60000 --testTimeout 60000 --no-file-parallelism

npx vitest run test/core/query/completed-work.test.ts test/core/mutation/add-completed-work.test.ts test/cli/read-commands.test.ts test/cli/mutation-commands.test.ts --hookTimeout 60000 --testTimeout 60000 --no-file-parallelism

rollback.command: 1) Restore completed-work query and mutation policy from before this task. 2) Restore related CLI options/tests and rerun completed-work suites.

tasks.title: Optimistic concurrency and stale insert guard
signatures: async function applyPatchPlan(plan: PatchPlan, options: { dryRun: boolean; staleCheck?: boolean }): Promise<PatchResult>
function createPatchPlan(file: TextFile, operations: PatchOperation[]): PatchPlan
tasks.reference_pattern: Patch layer currently checks replace-line originals but does not re-read freshness before write.
implementation_guide: Apply same guard to evidence and completed-work insertions.
tasks.rationale: Concurrent mutations must not silently collide or write at stale positions.
pitfalls: Dry-run should not fail on later file changes.
Keep atomic rename.
Do not add lock files.
test_guide: Changed file before write returns stale error.
Generated ID collision retried or returns guidance.
Stale table insertion does not corrupt file.
dod: Generated ID mutations do not collide silently.

rollback.command: 1) Restore TextFile, read-text, patch, and mutation edits from this task. 2) Rerun patch and mutation suites.

tasks.title: CI workflow, coverage thresholds, and package smoke gate
tasks.reference_pattern: Use existing package scripts and package smoke tests as the base.
implementation_guide: Add GitHub Actions CI on Node 22.
tasks.rationale: Release governance needs repeatable automation, not only local discipline.
pitfalls: Add only required coverage dependency.
Do not require secrets.
Keep perf timeout.
dod: Package smoke proves full rules loading.

rollback.command: 1) Remove CI workflow and coverage script/config added by this task. 2) Restore package smoke test edits and rerun smoke tests.

tasks.title: Full regression and release verification
tasks.reference_pattern: Use package command list and release check entry point.
implementation_guide: Record command names and exit codes for evidence.
tasks.rationale: Evidence must come from full regression across all touched surfaces.
pitfalls: Do not record failed commands.
Do not weaken tests.
Do not add v1.2.0 completed row before verification.
test_guide: First failure maps to owning Phase.
dod: Failures are routed before evidence work.

rollback.command: Verification task only. No file rollback is associated with this task.

tasks.title: Update SRS evidence, statuses, summaries, and Completed Work Log
tasks.reference_pattern: Use current index summary rollups and Completed Work Log structure.
implementation_guide: Add evidence rows using passed commands only.
Release v1.2.0 only after readiness passes.
Add one Completed Work Log row.
tasks.rationale: Implementation is complete only when SRS status and evidence reflect verified behavior.
pitfalls: Completed Work Log is summary only.
Evidence rows must not contain pipes.
Do not mark v1.2.0 released before readiness passes.
test_guide: Completed Work Log row has ISO date, target v1.2.0, and one-line summary without pipes.
dod: All v1.2.0 requirements have passing evidence.
Completed Work Log contains one v1.2.0 row.

rollback.command: 1) Remove only evidence, status, summary, and Completed Work Log edits made by this task. 2) Re-run validate and release acceptance to confirm the rollback state.
